svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 120 x 80 mm plus a tab each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each 80 mm edge: two tabs and a T-slot between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: across the stays 200 mm ahead of the rear axle, 480 to 560 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: it braces the stays' upper strips against buckling (FTK-CAL-001).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stays stand parallel, 120 mm apart, with the bridge fitted.
